earnings.title: WASTE CONNECTIONS REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND RAISES FULL YEAR OUTLOOK
highlights: Net income of $359.2 million, and adjusted EBITDA * of $895.8 million, or 34.0% of revenue, above expectations
Net income and adjusted net income * of $1.43 and $1.58 per share, respectively
Revenue in the third quarter totaled $2.638 billion, up from $2.458 billion in the year ago period.
Year to date closed acquisitions of approximately $130 million in annualized revenues

quotes.text: Another top to bottom beat in the period was driven by continued strength in operational execution along with improving trends in landfill activity and commodity-driven revenue.
